children: LayerZero's Zero mainnet goes live on November 30, 2026, with LayerZero ATLAS as its first application. The launch starts with Open ATLAS across more than a dozen trading venues. The Layer 1 blockchain targets up to 2 million transactions per second.
The network activation could change how traders value ZRO by putting the blockchain and its first application into operation together, providing a basis for fundamental and speculative repricing.
The countdown begins: Zero mainnet and lzATLAS go live on November 30.

title: LayerZero: Zero mainnet launches with ATLAS across over a dozen trading venues - 30 Nov 2026
